§14.9.18.4 1) a) + §14.9.14.4 3): a Roslyn-built C# host calls GOBACK and EXIT PROGRAM modules via ProgramRegistry.CallProgram; the host resumes at each call site, exit 0 || editions corrected from 85,2002,2014,2023 to 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3320, docs/VERSION_TEST_MATRIX_DESIGN.md P2.10): §2023:14.9.18.4 GR3 (GOBACK in a program not under a calling runtime element) is the rule this item documents; GOBACK is a COBOL-2002 statement (§2002:14.8.17.3 GR2 states the rule; the 1985 text has no GOBACK statement).

kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m). The default sharing mode is a function of the OPEN mode: OPEN INPUT establishes SHARING WITH READ ONLY and OPEN OUTPUT / I-O / EXTEND establish SHARING WITH NO OTHER (FileRegistry.ImplementorDefaultSharing, read once in SharedOpenAttempt: phrase ?? clause ?? default). Every arbitration is Table19.Conflicts, a plain lookup of the printed table; the null 'undetermined' mode, its universal quantifier and FileRegistry.Conflicts are deleted. The GnuCOBOL basis (rule 1) is the cross-run-unit lock posture (shared for input, exclusive otherwise). Golden 2002/pb322_default_sharing_by_open_mode pins the pairs (INPUT+INPUT 00/00, INPUT then I-O/EXTEND/OUTPUT 61, I-O then INPUT/I-O 61, LOCK MODE-only SELECT the same default, free again after the readers close); unit:OpenTable19Tests.ImplementorDefault_IsAFunctionOfTheOpenMode pins the function and its consequences over all 16 mode pairs. kb/Work PB670 LANDED (owner determination 2026-10-23, option (i)): at --std 85 the file sharing facility is not in effect (Annex A.4.7 is optional and A.4.1 makes its rules and I-O status values optional with it; the SHARING and LOCK MODE clauses are COBOL-2002 introductions). The implementor-defined default of 9.1.15 is the mode that restricts nobody: Table 19 is not asked, no file lock is taken against other run units, every OPEN of a file another connector holds answers 00 (OUTPUT beside a holder creates the empty file), a host refusal by a process outside the run unit answers 30, and 61 is never produced. One read: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility through FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect. Golden pb670_cobol85_no_sharing_facility (GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 gives the same statuses); SharingFacilityEditionTests pins every pair of opens in every organization at 85 and at 2002. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/IO/FileRegistry.cs#Conflicts (FileRegistry.Conflicts was deleted; Table19.Conflicts (OpenTable19.cs) is the one arbitration lookup) || editions corrected from 85,2002,2014,2023 to 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3320, docs/VERSION_TEST_MATRIX_DESIGN.md P2.10): §2023:14.9.27.4 GR23 (the implementor-defined sharing mode when neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is specified) is the rule this item documents; the sharing facility is COBOL-2002 (§2002:14.8.26.3 GR22, §2002:9.1.14); the 1985 text has no sharing mode, and the compiler at --std 85 has no sharing facility (golden pb670_cobol85_no_sharing_facility, FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect).

kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m): the sharing mode established for a connector with neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is one of the three standard modes chosen by the OPEN mode (INPUT = READ ONLY, otherwise NO OTHER), also for a LOCK MODE-only SELECT and for an OPEN whose only phrase is RETRY (both register no sharing, so SharedOpenAttempt falls through to the default).
